_comment: Example of a fully populated VideoEntry — the Talkie dashboard video

content.narrative: A walkthrough of Talkie's two main surfaces: the HOME dashboard showing daily usage stats (109-day streak, 391 memos, 18.6k dictations), top apps, shortcuts, and activity heatmap — then navigating to the LIBRARY Readouts tab showing AI-generated spoken summaries with full context (source app, LLM model, voice provider, latency).

scenes.description: Claude Code terminal showing Compose demo code — transition from previous recording session

Talkie HOME dashboard — 109-day streak, 113 today, 391 memos, 18.6k dictations, 6.6k words. Top apps: iTerm2 (15,828), Codex (1,076), Chrome (636), Ghostty (448), ChatGPT (359). Shortcuts: Compose (C), Record (R), Dictations (D), Notes (N), Screenshots (S). Green activity heatmap. Recent Memos list with timestamps. Recent Dictations list showing conversation fragments.

LIBRARY view → Readouts tab — scrollable list of readout summaries with timestamps. Entries include 'A video demo was copied and analyzed...', 'Here's a concise spoken summary...', 'You've made changes to 6 files...'. Filter bar: Today, This Week, More.
Readout detail pane — SELECTED TEXT shows Compose demo pipeline summary (4 numbered steps). CONTEXT section: Source=iTerm2, Mode=Explanation, Voice=ElevenLabs, Latency=1895ms.

Readout detail scrolled down — SERVICE CALLS section: LLM provider (llama-3.3-70b-versatile via Groq), system prompt ('You are helping someone understand a terminal selection quickly. Explain the selected text in a concise spoken-friendly way.'), followed by the generated explanation text.

production.note: Key Talkie content — dashboard + readouts. First 15s is claude-code transition, use startFrom=15 for reel clips.
